quote.text: June and August mass are inherently correlated because adults have a constant skeletal size after age 3. However, due to individual variation in summer fat accumulation, correlations were less than one, meaning that seasonal masses can be considered different traits (Pearson's correlation: r = .75; N = 472 individual‐year observations).
